messages:
ana: Quick sync on prompt-sets & evals UI — need design decisions on undo for bulk-approve, compact vs annotated regression diffs, scorecard wording, and keyboard/screenreader flows. Figma frames: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frames 20-25) :eyes:
kevin: My take: avoid a confirm modal for bulk approve. Use an in-app undo toast for small batches and an async job flow for large ones.
maria: What's "small" vs "large"? We should define thresholds. Also thinking about org-admin audit needs.
nana: Propose: <=100 items = toast undo (10s). >100 => confirm modal + create async job with job id and audit entry.
tom: Accessibility: toast must be announced (role=alert / aria-live=assertive). When undo completes, focus should return to the table header or the previously focused row.
kevin: Agreed. Add keyboard shortcut to undo (ctrl+z) when toast is visible, but ensure it doesn't conflict with browser behavior in other contexts.
eva-bot: Color/contrast scan: compact-diff purple background fails AA for 12px labels. Recommend darker token or 14px semibold.
maria: Ugh. For compact mode we intended a denser UI, but accessibility is not negotiable. Let's bump label weight to 600 and increase to 13px. If still failing, change color to #072146.
ana: Product decision: default mode for regression diffs? Annotated helps reviewers; compact helps power users. Thoughts on default and persistence?
kevin: Default annotated for new users, with a persistent user-pref toggle to switch to compact. Also offer a quick keyboard toggle (v) to switch views for power users.
maria: UX: annotated mode should auto-collapse unchanged blocks to reduce vertical noise. Users can expand groups with an affordance.
tom: For collapsing, ensure `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` are present; support keyboard arrows and enter to toggle. Implement a roving tabindex pattern for diff groups.
ana: Scorecard legend — PM feedback that "No judgement yet" was ambiguous. Proposed change: "Not scored" and add a short help tooltip: "Scores range 0 (fail) to 5 (excellent). Weights shown are defaults".
kevin: +1. Also add a contextual link to the scoring guide from the tooltip.
maria: Copy tweak for approve CTA: current: `Approve 18 results`. Suggest: `Approve 18 examples — marks them as passed for this suite. Undo available via banner.` Clearer about consequences.
ana: Good. Also for >1000 items, CTA should read `Start approval job` and present estimated processing time.
tom: When starting async job, announce job creation using polite aria-live and provide a focusable job-status card with job id and link to logs. For failures, assertive announcement plus link.
kevin: eva-bot reported a failing keyboard test: rs-compact-042 — inline comment button in compact-diff steals focus and blocks row navigation. Likely tabindex mishap. I'll fix by ensuring inline controls are reachable but don't stop row arrow handlers.
maria: Small microcopy change: "Select all in view" -> "Select all in view (approx.)" to avoid implying exactness. Finance will still get exact counts in billing modal.
ana: Good catch. Also add an explicit tooltip with exact count when available.
kevin: I'll add unit/e2e tests for: toast announcement, ctrl+z undo, focus restoration, and large-job flow. @tom can you review a11y PR?
tom: Yep. Also please add a short SR walkthrough to QA checklist: navigate table, expand group, add inline comment, bulk approve, undo via keyboard.
maria: I'll add the checklist and update the Figma copy accordingly.
ana: Thanks everyone. Quick poll: thumbs if you agree with annotated default + compact toggle preserved. :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
tom: :thumbsup:
ana: I'll update Figma, open PRs for copy + accessibility fixes, and link them here. Closing thread after PR links are added.
